name: Desert Cubs – Weekly SEO & Blog Auto-Update

nodes.name: Every Monday 6am
nodes.notes: Runs every Monday at 6:00 AM. Change the cron expression if you want a different schedule.

nodes.name: OpenAI – Generate Blog & Keywords
nodes.notes: Calls OpenAI GPT-4o. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY set in N8N Settings → Variables.

nodes.name: GitHub – Get seo.json SHA
nodes.notes: Gets the current seo.json SHA — required by GitHub API to update an existing file.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message: $('Prepare GitHub Payloads').first().json.commitBlog, content: $('Prepare GitHub Payloads').first().json.blogBase64, branch: 'main' }) }}

nodes.name: GitHub – Push New Blog Post
nodes.notes: Creates a new blog post HTML file in content/posts/ on the main branch.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message: $('Prepare GitHub Payloads').first().json.commitSeo, content: $('Prepare GitHub Payloads').first().json.seoBase64, sha: $input.first().json.sha, branch: 'main' }) }}

nodes.name: GitHub – Update seo.json
nodes.notes: Updates content/seo.json with the new AI-generated keywords.

meta.notes:
SETUP REQUIRED — Before activating this workflow, set these two variables in N8N Settings → Variables:
  OPENAI_API_KEY  — your OpenAI API key (starts with sk-...)
  GITHUB_TOKEN    — GitHub Personal Access Token with 'Contents: Read & Write' permission on the PrashanChamara/desert-website repo

Once set, click the toggle to activate. The workflow runs every Monday at 6am and:
  1. Asks GPT-4o to research trending UAE cricket topics and write a blog post
  2. Commits the new blog post HTML to content/posts/ on main branch
  3. Updates content/seo.json with fresh keywords
  4. GitHub Actions automatically deploys the changes to your live server
